Package com.tonic.analysis.pdg.sdg

Class SDG

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tonic.analysis.pdg.sdg.SDG
  • public class SDG
extends Object
    System dependence graph - the per-method PDGs joined by parameter and summary edges at resolved call sites.
